sources.fullCitation: Ted Fio Rito and his orchestra. “Love Song of Tahiti.” Brunswick 7446, matrix C971; recorded 6 May 1935. YouTube transfer published by Croonr1, who identifies the vocals as Muzzy Marcellino with The Debutantes and credits music to Bronislaw Kaper and Walter Jurmann and words to Gus Kahn.
sources.title: Love Song of Tahiti — Brunswick 7446
sources.creator: Ted Fio Rito and his orchestra; Muzzy Marcellino, vocal
sources.researchNote: The independent Brunswick 7300 Series Numerical Listing identifies “Love Song of Tahiti” by Ted Fio Rito on Brunswick 7446, matrix C971, dated 6 May 1935; the coupled side is “You’re All I Need”, matrix C972, from the same session. The source date describes that recording session, not the commercial issue date. The upload identifies the transfer as Brunswick 7446, but does not show the label; the particular transferred copy and take remain unverified. The vocal identification and authorship statement are supplied by the uploader, not by that numerical listing.
